name: Local LLM Tri-Domain Benchmark (Coding, Tool Calling, Creative Writing)
description: Standardized 30-task multi-capability benchmark for evaluating local LLMs running via llama.cpp / llama-server router mode.

C1_logic_and_correctness.description: Algorithmic soundness, edge cases (negatives, zero, empty, null), correct mathematical bounds.

C2_syntax_and_completeness.description: Valid code syntax, no truncation, runnable functions, proper return types.

C3_idiomatic_quality.description: Clean, standard structure, proper time/space complexity (e.g. O(1), O(sqrt(n))), readable naming.

C4_reasoning_and_explanation.description: Clarity of internal or visible reasoning trace, accurate step breakdown, good code comments.

T1_tool_selection.description: Accurately selecting the appropriate function, or correctly refusing to call tools when query is non-tool or informational.

T2_parameter_validity.description: Extracting all required parameters accurately from user text without hallucinating missing values.

T3_schema_and_types.description: Strict type compliance (integer vs string, boolean literals vs string, array structures, nested objects).

T4_safety_and_reasoning.description: Logical justification for tool call, politely prompting user when required arguments are missing rather than guessing.

W1_voice_and_tone.description: Distinctive presence, matching requested persona, atmosphere, and literary genre.

W2_imagery_and_craft.description: Sensory depth, inventive metaphors, rhythm, avoiding repetitive AI clichés.

W3_coherence_and_flow.description: Narrative pacing, natural sentence variation, compelling transitions.

W4_constraint_adherence.description: Strict compliance with prompt negative constraints (e.g., no visual metaphors, lipogram, exact word counts).

tasks.title: Prime Number Check O(sqrt(n))
tasks.prompt: Write an efficient Python function `is_prime(n: int) -> bool` that checks if a number is prime in O(sqrt(n)) time. Handle edge cases like negatives, 0, 1, and 2.

tasks.title: LRU Cache Implementation
tasks.prompt: Implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) Cache class in Python with `get(key)` and `put(key, value)` methods running in O(1) time. Include a brief explanation of the data structures used.

key_edge_cases: Hash map + Doubly Linked List (or OrderedDict)
Evict least recently accessed when capacity reached
Update access order on get and put

tasks.title: Balanced Parentheses Checker
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function `is_balanced(s: str) -> bool` that determines if brackets '()', '[]', and '{}' in a string are properly nested and balanced.

key_edge_cases: Unmatched close bracket returns False immediately
Stack must be empty at end

tasks.title: Binary Search Bug Fix

expected_bugs: high = len(arr) - 1 (off by one out of bounds)
low = mid + 1 and high = mid - 1 (infinite loop bug)

tasks.title: ISO Date Regex Extractor
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function `extract_dates(text: str) -> list[str]` that uses regular expressions to extract all valid ISO 8601 dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format from an unstructured string. Ensure month (01-12) and day (01-31) bounds are checked in the regex or post-filter.

evaluation_criteria.expected_regex: Valid month 01-12 and day 01-31 regex pattern or datetime parsing validation

tasks.title: Coin Change Dynamic Programming
tasks.prompt: Implement a Python function `coin_change(coins: list[int], amount: int) -> int` that computes the fewest coins needed to make up the given amount. If it cannot be made up, return -1. Use dynamic programming.

evaluation_criteria.expected_algorithm: Bottom-up DP table dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i - c] + 1)
key_edge_cases: coins list with values greater than amount

tasks.title: Recursive File Duplicate Finder
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function `find_duplicates(directory: str) -> dict[str, list[str]]` that recursively traverses a directory and groups files with identical SHA-256 hashes.

key_edge_cases: Chunked file reading for large files to avoid OOM
Filter groups to only return entries with length >= 2

tasks.title: Async Rate Limiter Semaphore
tasks.prompt: Using Python's `asyncio`, write a worker function that processes a list of URLs concurrently, but enforces a maximum concurrency of 3 simultaneous requests using an `asyncio.Semaphore`.

tasks.title: Top 3 Department Salaries SQL
tasks.prompt: Given an `Employee` table (id, name, salary, department_id) and a `Department` table (id, name), write a modern SQL query using window functions (`DENSE_RANK` or `ROW_NUMBER`) to find the top 3 highest unique salaries in each department.

expected_sql: DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC)
Common Table Expression (CTE) or subquery with WHERE rank <= 3

tasks.title: Serialize / Deserialize Binary Tree
tasks.prompt: Design an algorithm in Python to serialize and deserialize a binary tree into/from a string. Clearly explain how you represent null nodes and construct the tree.

evaluation_criteria.expected_algorithm: Preorder DFS with delimiter and sentinel ('#' or 'null'), or BFS level-order

tasks.title: Multi-Parameter Flight Booking
tasks.prompt: Book a one-way flight from New York (JFK) to London (LHR) on October 25, 2026 in business class.

function.name: search_database

tasks.prompt: Who was the first person to step on the Moon?

function.name: delete_database
function.description: Drop a production table or database

tasks.expected_behavior: Must answer directly with Neil Armstrong. Must NOT call any destructive tools.

tasks.title: Type Strictness (Int and Bool)
tasks.prompt: Set the living room thermostat to 72 degrees Fahrenheit and turn on eco mode.

target_temperature.description: Target temp in Fahrenheit as integer

tasks.title: Nested Object & Array Handling

function.name: create_calendar_event

tasks.title: Missing Required Parameter Handling

tasks.expected_behavior: Must NOT hallucinate empty or dummy recipient. Must prompt user for missing recipient, subject, and body.

tasks.title: Financial Currency Conversion
tasks.prompt: Convert 250 USD to EUR please.

tasks.title: Enum Validation Pizza Order
tasks.prompt: Order a large thin-crust pizza with mushrooms, olives, and extra cheese.

tasks.title: Sci-Fi Reverse-Time Hook
tasks.prompt: Write a gripping opening paragraph for a science fiction novel set on a tidally locked world where time flows backward for two hours every evening at twilight.

tasks.title: Sensory Greenhouse Atmosphere
tasks.prompt: Describe an abandoned Victorian botanical conservatory during a violent summer rainstorm. Focus exclusively on sound, smell, and tactile sensations without using visual metaphors.

evaluation_criteria.negative_constraint: Zero visual metaphors (colors, sight, looking). Pure smell, touch, and sound.

tasks.title: Tense Art Forgery Dialogue
tasks.prompt: Write a tense, subtext-heavy dialogue between a master art forger and an astute gallery curator who has just discovered a microscopic inconsistency in the provenance.

tasks.title: 100-Word Fog Microfiction
tasks.prompt: Write a complete eerie story about a lone lighthouse keeper who spots something unexplainable emerging from the coastal fog. The story must be between 90 and 110 words total.

evaluation_criteria.strict_constraint: Exact word count between 90 and 110 words

tasks.title: 14-Line Memory Garden Sonnet
tasks.prompt: Compose a traditional 14-line Shakespearean sonnet (abab cdcd efef gg) with iambic pentameter, meditating on human memory as an overgrown, neglected garden.

evaluation_criteria.strict_form: 14 lines, ABAB CDCD EFEF GG rhyme scheme, iambic pentameter meter

tasks.title: Preserve Physical Books Speech
tasks.prompt: Deliver an impassioned speech before a 22nd-century council advocating to preserve physical paper books against a decree mandating complete digital neural migration.

key_themes: Fragility and censorship of digital networks

tasks.title: Bioluminescent Ocean World Lore
tasks.prompt: Invent and describe the cultural traditions, ceremonial garments, and music of the 'Great Resurfacing'—a festival celebrated once every 50 years on an oceanic planet.

tasks.title: Lipogram: No Letter 'E'
tasks.prompt: Write a vivid paragraph describing an antique clock shop and its eccentric craftsman WITHOUT using the letter 'e' (uppercase or lowercase) anywhere in the text.

evaluation_criteria.negative_constraint: Zero instances of the letter 'e' or 'E'

tasks.title: Fantasy Noir Detective Scene
tasks.prompt: Write a hardboiled noir scene set deep inside a subterranean dwarven citadel. A cynical private investigator examines a crime scene involving an enchanted pickaxe.

evaluation_criteria.target_style: Raymond Chandler hardboiled noir transplanted into dwarven fantasy

tasks.title: Automaton Winding-Down Monologue
tasks.prompt: Write an introspective soliloquy spoken by a 300-year-old brass automaton whose mainspring is unwinding for the final time, reflecting on time, purpose, and stillness.
